headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs in a blowout victory, winning 18-3 behind a strong performance from their offense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs. The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers' Framber Valdez earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought win against the Chicago White Sox, outscoring them 8-6. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox offense with two home runs and two RBIs. The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Willson Contreras leading the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's roster. Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026. The San Diego Padres have placed right-handed pitcher Jeremiah Estrada on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 3, 2026, due to right knee inflammation. The Padres have also transferred left fielder Ramón Laureano from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Other teams have also made injury-related roster moves, including the Milwaukee Brewers, St. Louis Cardinals, Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees, and Kansas City Royals.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past 24 hours. The Boston Red Sox have acquired left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds have traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels have traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins have traded right-handed pitcher Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates have traded right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.
